Owner decision: replace the claim's source (e.g. SRC-PMC12346081 INTRO: 'algor mortis (cooling of the body)') or keep as fixture.

claims.text: Our framework reinforces the need for a multidisciplinary approach to PMI research, and calls for an adaptive research cycle that aims to reduce uncertainty in PMI estimates via experimentation, modelling, and validation

Forensic toxicologists employ a range of analytical methods, including gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS), which are considered gold standards in the field.
Hence, this study aimed to investigate the potential application of Mandelin, Mecke and Marquis reagents in the presumptive testing for xylazine.
Spot/color tests offer presumptive testing based on chemical reactions between analytes and indicators.
Immunoassay results are also considered presumptive until confirmed by higher resolution techniques like gas or liquid chromatography-MS (GC-MS, LC-MS) methods.
All DOA/Tox screening immunoassays can be limited by false positives caused by cross-reactivity from structurally related compounds.
